OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the entity types it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `P1D` for one day).

ENISA_EUVD_API_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the ENISA EUVD API.

ENISA_EUVD_IMPORT_START_DATE.description: First run only: oldest last-update date to import. Can be absolute (e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z') or relative (e.g. 'P90D' for 90 days ago). Subsequent runs resume from the connector's persisted state.

ENISA_EUVD_TLP_LEVEL.description: Default TLP (Traffic Light Protocol) marking applied to every object this connector creates in OpenCTI.

ENISA_EUVD_MIN_SCORE.description: Only import vulnerabilities with a base score greater than or equal to this value (0 to 10). Vulnerabilities without a score are then excluded. Leave empty to import every vulnerability.

ENISA_EUVD_EXPLOITED_ONLY.description: Only import vulnerabilities with a known exploitation.

ENISA_EUVD_CRITICAL_ONLY.description: Only import vulnerabilities of critical severity (base score of 9.0 or more). Combined with `min_score`, the higher of the two thresholds applies.

ENISA_EUVD_INGEST_SOFTWARE.description: Enable/disable the import of Software observables and their 'has' relationship to each vulnerability. Off by default: a single vulnerability can reference many affected products, which increases the volume of objects created per run.
